hazards.control: Certified lifting gear; casing and tubing handling by trained crews.
Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Cementing head and wiper plugs
function: The head on top of the casing during a cement job that holds the bottom and top wiper plugs and releases them ahead of and behind the cement.

tabs.overview: The bottom plug wipes mud ahead of the cement and ruptures at the float collar; the top plug separates cement from the displacement fluid and bumps on the collar to signal the end of displacement. Plug release is confirmed by indicators on the head.
tabs.engineering: Rated for the pump pressure; plug sizes per the casing.
tabs.connections: Casing below; cement unit line in.
tabs.safety: High-pressure connections; plug release confirmed remotely.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 5CT (S27), API Spec 10A (S28), API RP 10D-2 (S30), field practice (S9). Sizes are public nominal values; the schematic depth is not to scale.
tabs.failure_modes: Plug not released, plug not bumping, head leaks.
